issues.issue: 2022 timeline row mentions GPT-4/Gemini era without exact chronology.
issues.treatment: Test source milestones or chronology only; do not derive exact release dates from era wording.

issues.issue: No unrestricted Turing test pass is a time/criterion-dependent assertion.
issues.treatment: Source-specific framing only; not a current universal factual answer.

issues.issue: PCA is placed under Clustering despite being a dimensionality-reduction method.
issues.treatment: Keep concept identified/flagged; do not accept a general PCA-is-clustering question.

issues.issue: Statistical ML/unstructured-data, billions-of-parameters and all-modern-LLMs/replaced-RNN statements are broad simplifications.
issues.treatment: Use qualified architectural distinctions, not universal impossibility or necessity claims.

issues.issue: Broad search optimality/completeness claims omit assumptions; RRT sits under heuristic search despite no required heuristic.
issues.treatment: State finite branching, cost and reopening conventions; do not teach plain RRT as requiring h.
Avoid treating spelling variants as separate methods; retain exact source evidence.

issues.issue: Near robot implies CanGrasp is an illustrative logical rule, not sufficient real-world grasp feasibility.
issues.treatment: Explicitly stipulate rule for logic questions; no physical inference.

issues.issue: RLHF deployments and few-demo/generalization claims are unqualified summaries.
issues.treatment: Test process distinctions rather than unsupported universal guarantees/deployment histories.

issues.issue: HabitatSim listed as dataset with 100K scans; type/count need clarification.
issues.treatment: Flag row, do not use as generally correct dataset-size answer. Other sizes explicitly source-table values.

issues.issue: Quick-reference categories overlap and include game systems as multi-agent examples.
issues.treatment: Use source-table membership or shared concepts, not assertions that every named system is a physical robot.
